suite.name: MTT 20bb · preflop · 50 hands · 117 decisions · seed 3

format.title: Tournament · 20bb (ante)
format.summary: Late-stage tournament: 20bb effective, 2x opens, 1bb big-blind ante, low SPR. Chip EV (no ICM).

solver.algorithm: Discounted CFR (α = 1.5, β = 0.5, γ = 3), alternating updates, exact best-response exploitability

betSizes.sizes: preflop opens 2, limp yes, 3-bet ×3, all-in · 0.33 mbb/hand

approximations: Heads-up preflop only (blind vs blind; Spin & Go heads-up), solved by the core's preflop CFR: push/fold at ≤ 12bb, min-raise trees at ≤ 30bb, 2.5x opens deeper (limps, one iso size, one 3-bet and 4-bet size, all-in).

Flop terminals of the deeper preflop trees are valued with an equity-realisation model (all-in equity scaled by position and SPR, see core/src/preflop.rs) instead of a postflop solve, so preflop EVs are approximate.
Preflop bb/100 is reported separately from postflop (hands) suites; hands do not continue to the flop.
No triviality filter: easy folds/raises are kept (see spreadPot). Chip EV only; ICM is not modelled.

variants.summary: Default: full state with derived facts (made hand, draws, pot odds, SPR) + one choice question
Raw facts only (cards, positions, pot/stacks/to-call, history, actions); no derived facts
v2 + hero equity and made-hand percentile vs villain's preflop range (Monte-Carlo), equity vs needed
eq, but equity vs villain's range narrowed by its actions (strength heuristic, no solver data)
v2 state; criteria rewritten as concise GTO theory (value/bluff/bluff-catch, MDF, polarisation)
v2 state; 3 independently answered choice questions (v2 / coach / solver phrasing), probabilities averaged
v2 state; one noul per action ('is <action> the highest-EV action?'), P(true) normalised
eqrange + exact nut ranking (holdings that beat hero now) + value-extraction guidance for strong hands
v2 + short-stack preflop guidance (≤25bb: limp/call, fold or shove; small raises rarely best)
nuts + guidance on what each bet/raise size is for (small = thin value/protection, large = polarised)

criteria.allin: All-in for 20 bb total (19.5 bb more): the villain can only call or fold. Right with strong hands, or with hands that profit from the villain's folds plus their equity when called.
criteria.call: Limp: complete the small blind (0.5 bb more) to see a flop in a 3 bb pot; the BB may check or raise. Right with hands that play well in small pots but gain little from raising.
criteria.fold: Fold: the hero gives up the hand and the chips already posted; the villain wins the 2.5 bb pot. Right with hands too weak to continue for 0.50 bb (calling needs about 17% equity before position effects).
criteria.raise_to_2bb: Raise to 2 bb: the hero puts in 1.5 bb more (pot becomes 4 bb, 18 bb behind); the villain may fold, call or re-raise. Right with hands that are ahead of the villain's continuing range, or as a bluff with hands that block strong holdings and play poorly when called.

action.instructions: You are advising the hero, the player whose turn it is, in the heads-up No-Limit Texas Hold'em spot described in the state. Pick the single legal action that maximises the hero's expected value against a strong, balanced, game-theory-optimal (GTO) opponent who cannot see the hero's cards. Weigh the hero's exact hand against the villain's likely range given the betting so far, blockers, pot odds, the stack-to-pot ratio and position. Bet and raise sizes are fixed; choose only among the listed actions.

game.blinds: SB 0.5 bb, BB 1 bb, plus a 1 bb big-blind ante (dead money in the pot)
game.card_notation: rank + suit: A K Q J T(10) 9-2; s spades, h hearts, d diamonds, c clubs
game.seats: SB is the button: acts first preflop, last postflop. BB acts last preflop, first postflop.
game.setup: Tournament · 20bb (ante): Late-stage tournament: 20bb effective, 2x opens, 1bb big-blind ante, low SPR. Chip EV (no ICM). Everyone else folded preflop; stacks as shown.
game.units: all amounts in big blinds (bb); pot includes the blinds, antes and every chip committed, including a raise being faced
game.variant: No-Limit Texas Hold'em, heads-up preflop (blind vs blind)

hero.hole_cards_spelled: Seven of spades and Two of clubs
hero.role: small blind and button: acts first preflop, last (in position) on every later street

state.preflop: Tournament, folded to the small blind: blind vs blind, 20bb, 1bb big-blind ante.

spot.pot_odds: call 0.50 bb to win a 2.5 bb pot

players.name: Best-EV oracle
players.summary: Always picks the highest-EV action — the ceiling.

players.name: GTO (sampled)
players.summary: Samples each action with its equilibrium frequency.

players.name: Calling station
players.summary: Checks or calls, never folds or raises.

players.name: Random
players.summary: Picks a legal action uniformly at random.
